subject.title: feat: add flexible multi-sidebar chat layout

question: Should the Control UI permanently replace the prior single sidebar split preference with the new per-session multi-column layout and its resulting upgrade behavior?
rationale: This is a new user-visible workspace model with persisted preference semantics; tests can establish mechanics, but they cannot determine whether the new default and migration experience match intended product direction.

options.title: Adopt the multi-column workspace
options.body: Accept the new per-session layout after a real browser proof covers fresh and upgraded profiles.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep the existing single-sidebar default and introduce the multi-column layout only behind an explicitly chosen product surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the workspace-model change until maintainers define the desired persisted-layout and migration contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the multi-column workspace
recommendation.body: Accept the new per-session layout after a real browser proof covers fresh and upgraded profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit and assignment history connects steipete most directly to the proposed workspace model and its persistence behavior.
